name_note: GTDB divides the classical genus Alistipes into several genera and Alistipes_A is one of them, so the literature cited here, which uses the name Alistipes, covers a broader group than this GTDB genus.

sentences.text: Alistipes is a bacterial genus of the phylum Bacteroidetes that widely colonizes the gut.
Since the first report of Alistipes in 2003, thirteen species and three subspecies have been isolated and identified from human faeces, urine, appendiceal lesions and rectal abscesses.
A narrative review reported that Alistipes enhances the efficacy of immunotherapies in cancer treatment, and summarised its roles in inflammatory bowel diseases, digestive cancer and lung cancer.

In 85 overweight individuals with metabolic syndrome and 66 with systemic lupus erythematosus, Alistipes was a discriminant taxon whose abundance was associated with small LDL particle concentrations.
